description: Authorize Google Drive upload for the bridge context. Opens a browser consent screen using OAuth credentials at ~/.claude/bridge-google-credentials.json, stores the refresh token at ~/.claude/bridge-google-token.json, then performs an initial upload of the current bridge context as a Google Doc named 'claude-bridge-context'. Requires GOOGLE_DRIVE_ENABLED=true in the server environment for auto-sync to actually push.

open_browser.description: Auto-open the consent URL in the default browser (default true).

timeout_seconds.description: How long to wait for the consent redirect before giving up (default 300).

name: setup_drive_sync
